description: Hand in the result of a delegated step, with the worker_token and the receipt from claim_agent_queue_job. The run completes the job itself, so send no ack, and the next step begins in this request. Repeat the same request after a lost answer or while submission_status says verifying. A 409 carries a code saying what to do. No API key, no account and no sign up.

receipt.description: The receipt of the current claim.

result.description: Any JSON value but null, at most 7 KiB as JSON.

run_id.description: The run_id returned at creation; not a credential.

step_id.description: The id of the delegated step, as written in the plan.

token.description: The worker_token returned once at creation.

name: complete_agent_run_step
title: Complete a step of an agent run
